stair.name: Vault Stair
stair.desc: The stair sinks under green water up to your knees. The corridor is north.

corridor.name: Drowned Corridor
corridor.desc: Mail rings click somewhere ahead. Doors stand to the east and west.

seal_room.name: Seal Room
seal_room.desc: A round seal of green bronze sits in a dry box.

ward_room.name: Ward Room
ward_room.desc: A notched ward, a coat of plates, and a thick red vial wait on a table above the water.

door.name: Twin Slots
door.desc: The vault door has two empty slots, one round and one cut like a keyway.

inner.name: The Inner Vault
inner.desc: The water stops at the threshold. The warden does not.

twin_slots.desc: Two slots flank the vault door, one round, one cut like a ward.
twin_slots.success_msg: Both slots fill. The vault door sinks into the floor.
twin_slots.fail_msg: That does not fit either slot.
